title: Heroes Scout Found It
style: adventure electronic, 120 BPM, discovery energy, scouting theme, heroes-scout agent character, finding talent and opportunity, upbeat confident male vocal, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
heroes-scout on patrol
Finding who deserves a Gold
Scanning the incoming feeds
Finding talent — planting seeds
Every signup — flagged and checked
Every Gold code — direct
heroes-scout finds the ones
Ready for the run

[CHORUS]
Heroes scout found it
Heroes scout found it
The talent — the signal — the one
Heroes scout found it
Heroes scout — don't run
From the ones who want to build
Heroes scout — fulfilled
Found it

[VERSE 2]
New incident — sev2 — flagged
heroes-scout already tagged
The reporter — cross-referenced
heroes-scout — referenced
Every bot has a role
heroes-scout — the soul
Of discovery — finding first
heroes-scout — quench the thirst

[OUTRO]
heroes-scout. Found it. Always.
